ash: Quick question — how do we surface 'rollforward' of cache credits in the cost dashboard when a model variant rollout changes cache behavior? tenant sees big negative savings after canary.
maria: Ugh, yeah that happened yesterday. When we replaced model@v1 -> model@v2 the prefetch credits didn't carryover and dashboard shows a drop. :facepalm:
chris: Are we sure it's a display issue and not the attribution pipeline? IIRC credits are keyed by model SKU + fingerprint. If SKU changes, credits look like new.
tamika: Right. We have 2 choices: (A) show a rollforward line that maps old SKU -> new SKU using rollout metadata; or (B) show an amortized 'transferred credits' note on the tenant card.
ash: +1 for (A) — UX clarity is better. But backend needs a mapping from rollout_id -> model_variants. Who owns that mapping? @chris?
chris: We do. We already emit rollout events to telemetry but not the SKU mapping in the econ export. I can add a small payload to the econ stream: 
```json
{"rollout_id": "r-123", "from_sku": "m-v1", "to_sku": "m-v2", "timestamp": 1712549800}
```
ash: That'd help. Console can then show a dotted line from v1 savings -> v2 as "rolled forward credits".
maria: UI question — should rolled credits be additive or annotate the original slab? PM wants conservatism so additive (show both) then let ops reconcile.
tamika: Additive is safest for billing, but confusing. Maybe default to additive with a small tooltip explaining amortization over 24h.
chris: Implementation note: econ export will need a new endpoint param `?include_rollforwards=true` and joins across telemetry. Sample API shape: 
```
GET /internal/econ/stream?start=1712540000&end=1712550000&include_rollforwards=true
```
ash: Any perf concerns? This will require a left-join on rollout events.
chris: We'll precompute daily rollforward map in a batch job and expose it as a small lookup table for the streaming join — should be fine.
maria: For UX, we also need a toggle in the cost card: "Show rollforward credits" (on/off). Default off for now.
tamika: Also add an alert when rollforward causes >20% negative delta post-rollout so SRE/PM can triage.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: New econ export schema PR landed in #pulls (link) — tests passing. :rocket:
ash: OK, action items: @chris add rollout payload to econ stream + API param; @maria add UI toggle + tooltip copy; @tamika add alert rule spike; I'll own docs for the behavior.
maria: Will mockup the dashboard card tomorrow and link here.
chris: I'll open the backend PR, estimate 2d.
ash: Thanks all.
